  (I : TwoSidedIdeal.{u_2} A) (a b b' : A),
  Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} I (HSub.hSub.{u_2, u_2, u_2} b' b) →
    Eq.{u_2 + 1}
      (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (Etingof.quotientAlgHom.{u_1, u_2} k A I)
        (HMul.hMul.{u_2, u_2, u_2} a b'))
      (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (Etingof.quotientAlgHom.{u_1, u_2} k A I)
        (HMul.hMul.{u_2, u_2, u_2} a b))
